evaluation: Case/question status and binding/source differences; no overall accuracy without independent references
audit_rule: Sort eligible bindings by sample rank, task ID and canonical binding. Seeded random sample at most 3 B MATCH bindings; then at most 3 difference items, prioritize cooccurrence witness rejected by typed executor (known failing pair), then cooccurrence extra UNKNOWN bindings, then A/B status disagreements. Deduplicate exact selected item; no top-up beyond actual categories. One source review per selected item.
material: New documents not used to develop these fixed tasks; dispute independence unverified
stop: 10 cases + at most 6 audit items; no new cases, semantic repair rounds, discovery or outcomes
